rows.question: eligible order attempts receive a reconciled successful outcome
rows.blind_spot: no application request outcome instrumentation is installed in the sandbox

rows.question: eligible order attempts complete within 250 ms
rows.blind_spot: application histogram is absent and the alert candidate still requires chapter-24 governance acceptance

rows.question: a routed read observes a known committed token within five seconds
rows.fallback: write a unique token and poll the declared read path
rows.blind_spot: no commit-correlated probe is installed; pg_lag is diagnostic only

rows.question: acknowledged order state satisfies domain invariants
rows.fallback: signed reconciliation run with a retained boundary and result hash
rows.blind_spot: no application reconciliation exporter is installed

rows.question: recent restore evidence remains within the 90-day control
rows.fallback: inspect the immutable chapter-22 restore manifest
rows.blind_spot: restore-run evidence is not exported as a metric

rows.question: PostgreSQL exporter can reach each declared instance
rows.fallback: Patroni API and direct read-only SQL
rows.blind_spot: exporter reachability does not prove a user journey

rows.question: sessions, transactions, waits and locks can explain a symptom
rows.blind_spot: one sample can miss a transient wait

rows.question: I/O, WAL, checkpoints, archive and replication can explain a symptom or recovery risk
rows.source: pg_io_*, pg_checkpointer_*, pg_archiver_*, pg_repl_* and native views
rows.fallback: direct read-only SQL plus pgBackRest evidence
rows.blind_spot: PostgreSQL I/O views do not separate disk from OS cache and archive counters do not prove restore

rows.question: freeze age, dead tuples, object growth and maintenance progress are visible
rows.source: pg_table_* plus native catalogs and progress views
rows.fallback: direct read-only SQL and object-size snapshots
rows.blind_spot: dead tuple estimates are not exact bloat

rows.question: queryid-level workload cost and reset boundaries are visible
rows.fallback: restricted interactive SQL and bounded logs
rows.blind_spot: normalized query identity can collide; sampled logs are not a complete population; the observed auto_explain analyze plus timing policy requires a separate overhead review

rows.question: ingestion, rule evaluation and notification machinery can prove its own operation
rows.source: VMAlert and Alertmanager APIs plus self metrics
rows.blind_spot: zero notification failures without a receipt canary does not prove delivery

rows.question: PostgreSQL, PgBouncer, Patroni and pgBackRest events are searchable
rows.fallback: restricted host journal and log files
rows.blind_spot: this exercise deliberately does not export or inspect log bodies

rows.question: a sampled request can be followed across service boundaries
rows.fallback: bounded correlation identifiers in metrics, logs and events
rows.blind_spot: no pg36_shop application spans are asserted

rows.question: accepted alerts reach the intended role without touching a real receiver
rows.source: offline Alertmanager configuration and route tests
rows.fallback: reviewed route tree and receipt drill before production
rows.blind_spot: offline resolution does not prove a real integration can deliver
